response: {"verdict":"fail","criteria":[{"id":"US-2-AC1","met":false,"note":"The fields exist and are structured (last day worked, first day absent, nature of absence, free-text details) and they flow through to the confirmation, but none of them is enforced. A sponsor can submit with every claim-detail field blank; `showConfirmation()` then substitutes the literal 'Not stated' for nature, last day worked and first day absent, and the absence-details textarea is never read at all — it appears in no confirmation field and in no submitted payload. A packet that reaches intake with no employment or absence information cannot open a file, which is exactly what the criterion requires.
